competitors.name: Frozen pizza category / Circana
competitors.action: Supermarket News reported Circana MULO+ data showing U.S. grocery unit sales down 1.1% in June 2026 while dollar sales rose 1.4%. Frozen meals fell 2.2% in units, frozen pizza dropped 3.3%, frozen breakfast fell 2.8% and frozen side dishes fell 4.7%. For Real Dough, the signal is that the frozen pizza set is still under unit pressure even as shoppers trade selectively across frozen, so premium items need a clear velocity case.

competitors.name: Target / Walmart / Amazon Prime Day retail events
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported Placer.ai findings that Amazon's June 23-26 Prime Day event lifted traffic at competing mass retailers, with Target traffic up 16.3% versus the year-to-date weekday average on day one and Walmart up 4.7%. The signal for Real Dough is that deal events are now cross-channel traffic drivers for grocery and essentials, making event-based promotional readiness more important for freezer brands.

competitors.name: New Jersey grocery pricing regulation
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported that New Jersey legislators passed the Fair Price Protection Act, which would ban grocery stores and third-party grocery delivery platforms from using AI and consumer surveillance data to charge different shoppers different prices for the same items and would place a moratorium on electronic shelf labels in grocery stores. The signal is that pricing technology and loyalty-data use are becoming regulatory issues, not just retailer operating choices.

trends.context: Circana data cited by Supermarket News shows frozen pizza underperforming total grocery unit movement, increasing the importance of retail velocity, price architecture and clear reasons to trade up.
